fraction.description: plain API with the custom number type set to Fraction (fraction.js): unitF(new Fraction(x), from).to(to).getValue()

plain.description: unit(x, from).to(to).getValue() per value (parses both unit strings every call)

reuse.description: source and target unit objects built once; unit.setValue(x).to(targetUnit).getValue() per value
